purpose: Apple Developer Program License Agreement: an app that is a programming environment must keep executable code within 80% of the viewing area and must indicate the programming environment conspicuously.
method: The Build screen was launched directly with -CrabrixTab build on a Release build, screenshotted with simctl, and the editor pane's pixel bounds were read from the screenshot's own separator lines. The measured rectangle is the whole source editor, its line-number gutter included, against the entire screen — status bar and home indicator counted as viewing area rather than excluded, which is the conservative direction.

measurements.state: maximum editor: Code tab selected, file sidebar and inspector both collapsed
maximum editor: Code tab selected, project sidebar and build inspector both open, which is the default workspace

notes: Portrait is the worst case on iPhone: the chrome above and below the editor has a fixed height in points, so a shorter landscape screen lowers the editor's share rather than raising it.
The persistent RUST PROGRAMMING ENVIRONMENT bar sits directly above the editor on both size classes and carries an accessibility label naming the environment and the bundled toolchain.
Screenshots in this folder are stored at half scale; the pixel bounds above refer to the full-resolution captures.
